ammonia.reason: Surface deamination of amino acids by P. camemberti/Geotrichum releases NH3 raising rind pH to ~7.7.

animal_barnyard.reason: Trace p-cresol/indole from tyrosine/tryptophan catabolism; clean bloomy make keeps very low.

bitter.reason: Rennet hydrophobic peptides largely degraded by P. camemberti aminopeptidases, low residual bitterness.

blue_moldy.reason: White P. camemberti not P. roqueforti; low methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone/2-undecanone.

browning.reason: Free amino acids plus residual galactose/lactate in moist paste drive moderate Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Citrate fermentation by Lactococcus/Leuconostoc to diacetyl/acetoin plus C4-C12 delta-lactones.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: P. camemberti and Geotrichum lipolysis/proteolysis releasing butanoic and 3-methylbutanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: 23% fat, ~56% moisture plus rind-to-center proteolytic softening gives creamy flowing paste.

crumbliness.reason: Deacidified elastic rennet curd, not dry or granular; bends rather than crumbles.

firmness.reason: High moisture ~56% plus mold proteolysis softening from rind inward gives soft supple body.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol at low level by surface flora.

fruity.reason: Esterase formation of ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from fatty acids plus ethanol.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in caproic/caprylic/capric and 4-methyloctanoic acids; no goat character.

malty_nutty.reason: Low Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal and 2-methylpropanal from leucine/isoleucine/valine catabolism.

melt.reason: High-moisture rennet gel with demineralized, proteolyzed casein flows readily on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: P. camemberti oxidation of linoleic acid to 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one, defining bloomy rind.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free fat from lipolyzed bloomy paste releases some oil on melting.

sour_vinegar.reason: Residual lactic acid from starter with minor acetic/succinic acid; lactate retained in Coulommiers.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata kneading; casein network lacks aligned demineralized stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Limited methionine demethiolation to methanethiol/dimethyl sulfide/disulfide vs washed-rind.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted; slight sweetness from glycerol, alanine/proline and lactones.

umami.reason: Rennet plus mold proteolysis releasing glutamate-rich peptides and free Glu.
